title: The Third Page - Pain of Awakening
next_chapter_hook: Ye Qing supported the swaying Chen Ji and murmured softly: "So you've been trading your life for intelligence all along..."

text.content: Deep in the dark underground, Chen Ji knelt on one knee, the torn page in his hand radiating a sinister bronze-colored glow. A moment ago he had been contemplating "what exactly is the Tianji Record," and in the next instant that light squirmed like a living thing, drilling into his skin along his fingertips and directly reaching his heart vessels. Agonizing pain exploded from his chest, as if a red-hot iron hammer was being repeatedly hammered within his body.

"Cough—" A mouthful of black blood sprayed out, and Chen Ji felt his Heavenly Fate Value draining at a near-mad rate. Through blurring consciousness, he saw a number flickering before his eyes: 87... 82... 76... Decreasing every second, as if an invisible serpent was sucking his lifespan. He wanted to let go, but that torn page seemed fused to his palm, impossible to shake off.

Mo Xiansheng's broken voice rang in his mind: "The third page... Cause and Effect Tracing... the price is... Heavenly Fate..." The voice came in broken fragments, like a sigh across infinite distance. Chen Ji gritted his teeth, veins bulging on his forehead, cold sweat mixing with blood beads sliding down his cheeks. He quickly calculated in his heart: remaining Heavenly Fate Value was less than seventy points, if this continued...

Just then, a graceful figure swept out from the darkness, the unique cold aura of the Demonic Path assailing him. Ye Qing's hands formed complex magic seals, and a layer of pale purple mist surged from her palm, enveloping Chen Ji entirely. That mist was ice-cold upon contact yet mysteriously suppressed the raging pain within.

"Don't touch me!" Chen Ji tried to refuse, but his body no longer obeyed. A slight frown creased Ye Qing's brow; she could feel something within this man being forcibly awakened, the intensity of that power far exceeding her expectations. She did not retreat, instead pressing her other hand onto Chen Ji's shoulder, the purple mist growing increasingly dense.

Chen Ji felt himself torn into two parts—one enduring the agonizing pain of awakening, the other protected by that purple mist, preventing him from dying on the spot. He recalled the deal with Ye Qing at Black Wind Valley, her tragic past being manipulated by the Holy Sect, the prophecy he had shown her using the Tianji Record... Why was this woman saving him?

Just at this moment, the third page's ability awakened abruptly! Chen Ji's pupils turned pure gold in an instant, all color draining from the world, leaving only countless intertwined rays of light—those were the threads of cause and effect, connecting all things' past and future. He saw the moment of his own birth, saw Chen Xuan's layout before his death, saw a clue that made his whole body go cold...

dialogue.content: "Impossible... This is impossible..." Chen Ji's voice was hoarse and trembling, the scene he witnessed was too shocking. Chen Xuan—the previous owner of the Tianji Record—had also endured awakening pain in this same darkness before death, and his Heavenly Fate Value... also draining madly. The trajectory of fate, on these two people, overlapped so terrifyingly.

text.content: The scene reflected in those golden pupils grew increasingly clear: Chen Xuan lay in a pool of blood, clutching the Tianji Record tightly, his expression not fear but a relieved smile. That smile resembled Chen Ji's current expression by seventy percent. He finally understood—the Tianji Record choosing him was no accident—a necessary inheritance, a inescapable destiny.

text.content: Chen Ji fiercely closed his eyes, the True Qi in his body surging like boiling magma, colliding with his meridians. With immense willpower, he severed the connection with the cause-effect threads, the golden pupils slowly fading. But the moment of severance, a fierce backlash force pierced his Mental Sea like a steel needle, causing splitting headaches.

dialogue.content: "Mm..." He groaned, forcibly swallowing the metallic taste of blood rising in his throat. Although most of his Heavenly Fate Value was preserved, the cause-effect backlash damaged his Mental Sea, temporarily preventing him from using the third page's ability again. He opened his eyes, just meeting Ye Qing's purple eyes filled with worry.

choices.description: "Let Ye Qing's Demonic Path mist help stabilize the raging power within, using her strength to complete this awakening. Although it will create a debt of gratitude, it will allow more complete acquisition of the new ability."
choices.visible_cost: Relationship with Ye Qing advances further
choices.visible_reward: Third page ability fully unlocked, Heavenly Fate Value loss reduced to 15 points

text.content: Chen Ji hesitated for a moment, ultimately choosing to accept. He said nothing more, merely giving a slight nod. Upon seeing this, a flash of surprise crossed Ye Qing's eyes before she infused more Demonic Path mist into his body. That purple mist wound around his raging meridians like silk threads, carrying away the burning pain.

dialogue.content: "You actually trust me." Ye Qing's voice carried some complexity, "Aren't you afraid of Demonic Path things?" Chen Ji勉强 pulled out a smile, his voice weak yet with a hint of playfulness: "You've already poured the mist in, what could I possibly be afraid of? Worst case... we get dragged into the Demonic Path together."

text.content: A fierce light flashed in Chen Ji's eyes as his hands suddenly gripped that torn page, frantically pulling it out from his body. It felt like tearing his own soul, the agony causing his consciousness to nearly collapse. But he gritted his teeth,，一声不吭, and剥离 the third page from the Tianji Record.

dialogue.content: "Foolish..." Mo Xiansheng's voice sounded in his mind, carrying a sigh, "The third page... hasn't fully fused yet... You will regret this..." Chen Ji wiped the blood from his mouth, coldly laughing: "Regret? Better than dying here now." He gazed at the fragment in his hand, a complex emotion flickering in his eyes.

text.content: The purple mist gradually dissipated, Ye Qing withdrew her hands, her face several shades paler than before—her consumption was considerable too, stabilizing Chen Ji's awakening. Chen Ji leaned against the cold stone wall, gasping heavily; the third page's ability had integrated into his Mental Sea, but the scene from that trace was like a thorn embedded in his heart, making him unable to calm for a long time.

dialogue.content: Ye Qing stared at Chen Ji's pale face for a long while, then suddenly spoke: "What did you see in the cause and effect? Making your expression... like you've seen a ghost." Her voice was no longer the previous haughty tone, but carried a hint of concern she herself hadn't noticed. Chen Ji gave no answer, merely quietly gazing at those purple eyes of hers.

text.content: After a moment, Chen Ji slowly spoke, his voice hoarse yet terrifyingly calm: "I saw a person... someone walking the same path as me. He also held the Tianji Record, also endured awakening pain here, and finally... died before dawn." Ye Qing's eyes slightly hardened; she seemed to understand something, yet didn't expose it.

dialogue.content: "So what?" Ye Qing's voice was soft, yet carried undeniable weight, "Are you planning to give up? Die on this path like him?" Chen Ji was stunned, then let out a low, dry laugh, the sound carrying both bitterness and determination: "Give up? I, Chen Ji, never learned how to write those two words."

choice.prompt: Ye Qing's question struck deep into the heart, Chen Ji must give a response. His attitude toward destiny will determine the path ahead...

choices.description: "Display a determination different from Chen Xuan's—he will break this cycle and walk his own path."

dialogue.content: Chen Ji slowly stood up, though his form still wavered slightly, the light in his eyes had reignited: "He died before dawn because he was alone. But I'm different—I have allies, have layouts, have... a sister not yet found." He glanced at Ye Qing, the corner of his mouth lifting into a faint smile: "This thing called destiny, I never believed in it."

dialogue.content: Chen Ji didn't answer immediately; instead, he closed his eyes and began organizing the information obtained from the cause-effect trace. In his Mental Sea, several key clues clearly emerged: the Tianji Record's inheritance mechanism, the truth of Chen Xuan's death, and... an existence hidden deeper, one that made him feel chills.

text.content: Ye Qing quietly watched this man's face as he calmed down, a strange feeling rising in her heart. In her understanding, no man could remain this composed after enduring such agony. The Demonic Path Saint had witnessed countless strong ones' collapse and madness, but Chen Ji... he was like a hidden blade in a broken sheath—inconspicuous ordinarily, but once drawn, it would kill without fail.

"You really are strange." Ye Qing suddenly said, her voice carrying a softness she herself hadn't noticed, "You're clearly a servant disciple, yet deeper than any true disciple from major sects. You were practically dying from pain just now, yet you're already scheming something." Chen Ji opened his eyes, glanced at her, with a hint of a smile: "Habit."

Just then, that eerie laughter sounded again from the depths, clearer than before, as if that existence had sensed the change in Chen Ji. Ye Qing's expression shifted, magic seals already forming in her hands. But Chen Ji slowly rose, put the Tianji Record fragment into his chest, the corner of his mouth lifting into a meaningful smile.

dialogue.content: "It wants to see me?" Chen Jiwhispered说道, his tone carrying an eerie calm: "Then let it wait. Right now... is not the time." He turned to look at Ye Qing, a flash of cunning in his eyes: "Saint Ye, this favor, I remember. When I understand the full truth of the Tianji Record, perhaps... I can help you break the Holy Sect's control."

text.content: Ye Qing's eyes slightly narrowed; she hadn't expected Chen Ji to proactively mention the Holy Sect's control. That was her deepest secret, the shackle she most wanted to escape. But before she could speak, Chen Ji had already turned toward the exit, his back solitary yet resolute. Ye Qing watched that retreating figure, then suddenly said softly: "Chen Ji... you'd better not die before me."

Chen Ji didn't look back, merely raised his hand slightly in response. In his mind, the scene from the cause-effect trace kept echoing: Chen Xuan's smile before death, that relieved expression, and... another name faintly emerging on the Tianji Record fragment. That name caused him a bone-deep chill, as if some enormous danger was approaching.

"Tianji Record... what exactly are you?" Chen Ji whispered to himself, his voice swallowed by the dark passage. At the same time, a new ability had been added to his Mental Sea—Cause-Effect Tracing. Although just barely entering the threshold, he could already vaguely sense the existence of cause-effect threads around him. This was the fourth ability the Tianji Record granted him, and also the most dangerous.

Walking out of that dark area, Chen Ji looked up at the sky. The eastern horizon was already showing a hint of dawn, sunrise approaching. He thought of the prophecy that Chen Xuan died before dawn, an inexplicable emotion rising in his heart. This time, he would not repeat that mistake. Whatever secrets lay behind the Tianji Record, whatever that terrifying existence plotted, he would personally break through all of it.

dialogue.content: Just then, Ye Qing's voice came from behind him, carrying urgency: "Chen Ji!" Chen Ji stopped, slightly turning his head. Ye Qing quickly walked to his side, hesitated, then took out a purple jade pendant from her sleeve: "This is a token from my Holy Sect. If you're in danger... crush it, and I'll sense it." Her voice was soft, yet carried a hint of nervousness she tried to hide.

text.content: Chen Ji took that warm jade pendant, glanced at Ye Qing. It had always been her demanding secrets and筹码 from others, yet today she was the one actively offering trust. This proud Saint of the Demonic Path now resembled a flustered young girl, lowering her eyes, not daring to meet his gaze. Chen Ji put the jade pendant into his chest, the corner of his mouth lifting: "Saint Ye, are you bribing me?"

dialogue.content: "Don't flatter yourself!" Ye Qing's face flushed slightly, then restored her usual cold demeanor, "I just don't want my investment to die so quickly. After all... you still owe me an answer about the Holy Sect." With that, she turned and vanished as a purple light in the dawn, leaving only a lingering cold fragrance in the air.

text.content: Chen Ji watched the direction where that purple light vanished, his smile gradually fading. He looked down at the purple jade pendant in his chest, then at the Tianji Record fragment in his palm, complex emotions flickering in his eyes. The price of the third page's awakening was heavy, but what he gained... might be more valuable than what was lost. Cause-Effect Tracing—this was his key to breaking the chess game.

The morning wind brushed his face, carrying away some of the exhaustion. Chen Ji took a deep breath and began walking toward the Tianqing Sect. His steps remained steady, as if that life-and-death struggle had never happened. But only he knew, deep in his heart a seed of unease had already been planted—Chen Xuan's death, the truth of the Tianji Record, and that terrifying existence hidden in the darkness... all of this portended an even greater storm approaching.

The first rays of sunlight pierced the clouds and fell upon the earth. Chen Ji looked up at that rising sun, a firm light flickering in his eyes. He was not Chen Xuan; he would not die before dawn. This time, he would personally grasp the Heavenly Secrets and defy fate! And right now, that purple jade pendant left by Ye Qing in his chest was radiating gentle warmth, like a silent promise.
